scope: AgentMIM commission upload dry-run parsing and troubleshooting

resolutions.symptom: Parsed XLSX total was $31,666.31 while PDF cover letter said $31,744.43.
resolutions.root_cause: A top-of-page continuation row combined detail and subtotal content; the parser treated group 713667 as a money-like value and missed the $78.12 subtotal commission.
resolutions.resolution: Use subtotal-specific financial amount extraction and preserve the active group header when page-break text malforms the subtotal row.

resolutions.symptom: Reward files looked suspicious because valid payments were stored under Bonus/Reward columns; group/production reward had only a bottom TOTAL row.
resolutions.root_cause: Kaiser reward statements use Bonus / Reward Amount or Bonus / Reward Total as commission-like payment sources. Renewal was also vulnerable to misclassification because the word renewal contains the letters new.
resolutions.resolution: Classify renewal before new_mbr, map member reward Bonus / Reward Amount as commission paid, and create one reviewable group-reward statement-total row from the bottom TOTAL row without allocating the amount across groups.
validation: dry-run confirms new reward $728.00, renewal reward $1,274.00, group reward $1,000.00

resolutions.symptom: Policy/client values appeared only on the first row of each group, continuation charge rows had blank policy/client cells, and subtotal rows doubled the parsed total.
resolutions.root_cause: The statement uses carry-forward policy/client rows and prints both broker subtotal sections and a final grand total in the same money column as charge detail rows.
resolutions.resolution: Add a California Choice parser that detects the real header, carries policy/client forward through continuation rows, keeps charge detail rows only, and drops TOTAL COMMISSIONS, Total ... Premium, TOTAL PAID COMMISSIONS, and final grand-total rows.
validation: direct process_file parses 58 rows, $10,334.80 total, and zero blank policy/client rows
direct prepare_historical_commission_upload preview returns 58 records and $10,334.80
dry-run confirms CalChoice_Stmt05.26.26Rec_05-28-26_JR.csv as ready with $10,334.80

tod_rule: Before changing commission parser logic, run a dry-run, compare parsed totals to source statement totals, inspect companion files, top rows, subtotal rows, carry-forward rows, OCR quality, and subtotal blocks, then update this log with evidence.
